note: Final v2 timeline (stage A: clean picture, no graphics/captions). Event ids = edl_v2.json. Times in seconds and frames (frame = round(t*fps)). src_in/src_out are seconds in the source clip (IRL: exact frame bounds src_frames). grew_s = final duration - edl duration (dialogue-protected events only grow). P_05 is a speed-ramped time-lapse: speed_effective is the mean source/timeline ratio and src_map gives the source time per timeline frame (for the clock overlay). sync_speech: caption from word_json within src_in..src_out. hud = edl_v2 hud block (corner/clock values) passed through.
